scope: New local BLE SDK send observer/quarantine only; not a whole-project absence-of-defects proof
findings: Timer callback only samples monotonic time and latches under existing BLE lock.
Late SDK return is checked before active clears; actual SDK outcome retained separately from local deadline.
Active slot survives until actual owner return; reconnect cannot clear quarantine.
Init claim/result survives resettable BLE state and prevents partial-startup object reuse.
executed_tests_reviewed: Independent ucontext SDK owner remains suspended while external observer latches deadline
CONF wait and idle do not trigger active-call timeout
limits: Quarantine is not SDK cancellation or a hard-real-time scheduling guarantee.
Recovery uses explicit existing USB RESTART; no automatic reboot loop added.

BLEGUARD rejected counts actual local BLE admission/send rejection paths, not all missing frames; TransportQueue no-enabled-network-sink path can returnESP_OK without queueing. Hostreceipt and layercounts remain distinct.
